hero.title: By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals: Savor Bengaluru's Beloved Taste of Tradition
hero.subtitle: Experience the rich heritage of authentic Indian cuisine and the comforting tradition of shared coffee.

about.title: Our Authentic Story
about.paragraph1: By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals is a vibrant celebration of India's incredible flavours and rich culinary heritage. Since 2012, we’ve been a beloved name in Bengaluru, crafting time-honored recipes that tell captivating stories of authentic Indian cuisine in every delightful bite.
about.paragraph2: Our journey began with a simple, heartfelt idea: 'By 2 Coffee,' representing a cup shared between two. This tradition sparked a legacy, making us a trusted and cherished destination for authentic Idli-Vada and coffee lovers who appreciate genuine taste and community spirit.
